reason: The README clearly describes a voice-input plugin that records microphone audio, performs speech-to-text through browser, local, or cloud engines, and inserts the transcription into the input field without automatically sending it.

summaries.zh: 通过麦克风录音并使用浏览器、本地离线模型或兼容 OpenAI 的云端 ASR 服务将语音实时转写到输入框。
summaries.en: Records microphone audio and transcribes it into the input field in real time using browser speech recognition, local offline models, or an OpenAI-compatible cloud ASR service.

capabilities: Captures microphone audio in the browser
Transcribes speech using Web Speech API, local offline models, or an OpenAI-compatible cloud ASR API
Writes interim and final transcription into the application input field
Installs dependencies, downloads models, and manages a local ASR backend process
Sends recorded audio to a configured external transcription service when cloud mode is selected
